methods_en: Hold the original Balance Band rule fixed across self-history takeover, prompt dilution and pure accumulated latent noise worlds. Self-opposition is zero in the latter two; the noise channel is outside the original three-source decomposition.
results_en: Near-optimal interval/original band: 13–33/12–31, 21–39/11–33 and 20–54/13–111; Jaccard=0.864/0.448/0.354. In pure noise, 73.5% of clearly bad time points still lay inside the original band.
interpretation_en: Source decomposition defines the monitored mechanism. Coverage can expand by explicitly adding other influence channels, as implemented in E39. The 73.5% denominator is clearly bad time points.
